maintenance_led.reason: Sells first-time consumer purchases of fragrance, body care and home fragrance products, consumed or gifted; not repair or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from consumers buying body care, candles and soaps in its own stores and online.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by selling its own branded products through its own stores and online channels, not by acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Consumers can easily switch to other retail fragrance and personal care brands; discretionary products with no switching cost.
